test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Quant (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The pie chart below shows the distribution of female employees working in a company in five different districts (A, B, C, D and E).

Total number of female employees in five districts = 136000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a50ad4da27d135366d5d6ea7ab653d0009ac833b832eb9fce838481d14b5add2.png] 

What is the total number of female employees working in a company in district C and district D?
solution:
**Calculations:**

Total number of female employees = 136,000

Percentage of female employees in district C = 30%

Percentage of female employees in district D = 15%

Female employees in district C = 30% of 136,000 = 0.30 × 136,000 = 40,800

Female employees in district D = 15% of 136,000 = 0.15 × 136,000 = 20,400

Total number of female employees in district C and D = 40,800 + 20,400 = 61,200
